lines.say: Thank you for calling Northside Studio. This is Ava, an AI assistant. How can I help you today?
Hi! Could I come in on Wednesday afternoon?
Of course. I have three p.m., or four thirty. Which suits you better?
Lovely. You're booked for Wednesday at three p.m.
I don't have an answer for that, and I don't want to guess. I'll ask the team to call you back today.
AI voice agents that book your customers. Twenty four seven.
